scientific_integrity: The square-case probability is an already known polar-shadow specialization; only the full nonsquare centroidal-section law and its sharp shape/height rigidity and stability are assessed as potentially new. Analytic proof given; numerical verification supports but does not replace proof. Historical priority may be incomplete.
scientific_limitations: Nondegenerate right rectangular pyramids; planes through the volume centroid with Haar-uniform orientation, not randomly offset affine planes. Rigidity is global; the displayed curvature estimate is local. An arbitrary nonrectangular base is not covered.
title: Sharp pentagonal-section probability and aspect-ratio rigidity for right rectangular pyramids
